svg.title: Activity diagram: How does one file get a verdict?
svg.desc: UML activity diagram with four swimlanes: entry point, parent process, worker process and external services. It shows the pipeline, the messages on the pipe and where time-out and failure paths end.

script, mail, prompt-guard, relationships, qr, archive, web,
Container members go through the same pipeline at depth + 1. A

With less than one 15 s poll left before the safety margin: sandbox

checked by check_reply() before any field is used. Kinds:
ready, log, ok, error, container, member, provisional,
'provisional' is the result the file gets if the worker has to
be stopped now. 'settled' and 'completed' need no more

and its helper programs, delete its temp folder,

Activity diagram: How does one file get a verdict?
One file, from submission to its final result, in an isolated scan (the default). Branch review/production-hardening, commit b6966f8.
